episodes.title: Isten Árnyéka a Földön
episodes.summary: Hungarian noble Hunyadi János wants to marry Mara Brankovic, the daughter of a Serbian count, but after the unexpected attack on Galambóc by the ottomans, things aren't so certain.

episodes.title: Királyok Királya
episodes.summary: The Hungarian king wishes to be the emperor of the Holy Roman empire. Hunyadi falls in love with Erzsébet but he needs to leave her home to go with the king. Mara worries for a woman who arrives to Constantinople.

episodes.title: Kelet és Nyugat Császára
episodes.summary: Now in Italy under Visconti, Hunyadi is well liked among the people, but all letters from his wife are being kept from him. Meanwhile Erzsébet gives birth to Hunyadi's son and tries to keep order in Hunyad village.
